fast.type: Sunnah fast · Ayyamul Bidh (white days) day 3
fast.why: Today is the 15th, the third and last white day. If you haven't eaten, you can still intend a sunnah fast before Zuhur. Next: Thursday 26 Nov, when deeds are presented to Allah.

blessing: The food and drink on your table. Today, say 'Alhamdulillah' after your first meal and make dua for those who have less.

verse.text: Indeed, the patient will be given their reward without account.

hadith.text: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever remains patient, Allah will make him patient. No one has been given a gift better and more vast than patience."

lesson.title: Fasting: forgetting while fasting
lesson.text: If a fasting person eats or drinks out of forgetfulness, the fast remains valid in the Shafi'i school; stop as soon as you remember and complete the fast. The Prophet ﷺ said: 'Whoever forgets while fasting and eats or drinks, let him complete his fast, for Allah has fed him and given him drink' (Bukhari 1933, Muslim 1155). Allah's religion is easy.

name.text: "Indeed, it is Allah who is the Provider, the possessor of firm strength" (51:58). Your salary and your meals come from Him; thank Him before you worry.
"He is the Knowing Judge (Al-Fattah)" (34:26). He opens doors you cannot see; end today trusting that.

world.text: Bulletin of the Atomic Scientists set it at 85 seconds to midnight on 27 Jan 2026, the closest ever, citing nuclear risk, AI and great-power rivalry.
Forecasters' chance of a 'World War Three' before 2050 (10M+ deaths, major powers involved).
Prof Jiang's latest lectures on geopolitics and where great-power conflict is heading.

Nuclear deterrence makes all-out war a losing move for every major power, so the stable outcome (flashing) is 'compete, don't fight': trade wars, arms races and proxy conflicts. The real danger is a misread in a crisis like Taiwan or Ukraine, which is why the clock and the forecast are rising. Meter: 2 of 5.
